description: Return the current workspace document (ops log + cursor + meta) plus the materialized mapPlan and layerFilters, in a shape suitable for save-to-file / share-by-URL / inspection. Pure read — no mutation, no credit charge. This is the full raw state for serialization; get_state returns a compact summary for display.
